blocked_bootstrap_local_status.scope: Local controller while actual hard-NFS bootstrap is pending; no SQLite/readiness

checks.isolated_startup: SIGTERM ended service and confirmed bootstrap child exit before server restoration; no SQLite or readiness
checks.outage: Metadata and source startup remained pending at 3-second observations
checks.restored: Stable root/namespace identity; metadata recovered and source lock became available

limitations: SLES 12 SP5 userspace on WSL2 kernel, not the SLES kernel or old CPU hardware.
Two controlled server containers/IPs/network namespaces and one client share a modern kernel; no physical NAS isolation, partition/reclaim, server reboot/power-loss or takeover evidence.

Four selected source-only outages after the first 1 MiB copy chunk, debug/release, blocked or following stop. Qualification-only source cache advice/rendezvous precedes the next read; require actual D, no read-completed marker, unchanged healthy-destination partial and healthy-peer I/O. Preserve original state/custody and partial allocation on recovery. No opposite failure directions, physical NAS isolation, exact in-flight RPC/settlement, persistent-disk, systemd or old-kernel qualification.
Service startup rejection is measured; production NFS and source deletion remain disabled.

independent_endpoints.scope: Two controlled NFSv4.1 server containers/net namespaces/IPs and tmpfs exports on one modern kernel; independent NFSD thread outages, not physical NAS failures or reboot/power durability.
